# setup again from another executable, job loaded
# each launchctl call, then the state of the files as it was asked
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=absent own=old
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=absent own=old
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=present own=old
bootout gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=present own=old
bootstrap gui/UID @USER_HOME@/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agent-archive.collector.plist  |  journal=present own=new
# exit 0, end: journal=absent own=new
